Sine, cosine, tangent of angles up to 18: Learn the values for 30°, 45°, 60° and 90°. For obtuse angles sin(180° − α) = sin α and cos(180° − α) = −cos α.
The law of sines: a / sin A = b / sin B = c / sin C = 2R. Use it with two angles and a side, or two sides and an opposite angle.
The law of cosines: c² = a² + b² − 2ab cos C. It reduces to the Pythagorean theorem at 90° and finds angles from three sides.
Dot product and the area of a triangle: S = (1/2)ab sin C. The dot product is |a||b| cos θ = x₁x₂ + y₁y₂, and it is zero exactly for perpendicular vectors.
